Select: canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units
Source: activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary
Join: activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno AND compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter: activities.assay_id = 1267250 AND activities.standard_type IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_units IS NOT NULL
Sort: standard_value ASC
Limit: 1000
